GAS-FUELED
MMAAYYHHEEMM
Dodge Charger Scat Pack ushers in a new era with the SIXPACK—our first-ever
3.0L Twin-Turbo SIXPACK engine. Tuned for maximum power and torque, its low-
inertia, high-flow twin turbochargers spool up fast, delivering a peak boost of
30 psi. The result: up to 550 horsepower and 531 lb-ft of torque, making it the most
powerful version of our award-winning Hurricane engine yet. Standard All-Wheel Drive
(AWD) grips hard off the line, but when it’s time to serve donuts, switch to
100 percent Rear-Wheel Drive (RWD) at the push of a button.
Dodge Charger Scat Pack 2-door shown in Redeye.

pages.text:
S T I L L T H E W O R L D ’ S Q U I C K E S T A N D
M O S T P O W E R F U L M U S C L E C A R
2
Engineered with an electric powerplant, Charger Daytona Scat Pack was born to be electrified without backing down from the muscle-first mantra the
Dodge Brand has always delivered. With maximum 670 horsepower and blistering 3.3-second 0–60 time, it launches like a slingshot, delivering
instant acceleration—without a drop of gas. Charger Daytona Scat Pack is race-prep equipped and packed with performance tech like Launch Control
to Drift/Donut Mode, proving it’s built for more than straight-line speed. With the world’s first Fratzonic chambered exhaust, it sounds every bit as
fierce as it drives. This is modern muscle: born electric, built Dodge.
Dodge Charger Daytona Scat Pack 2-door shown in Redeye.

Y O U D O N ’ T J U S T D R I V E I T —
Y O U C O M M A N D I T
The immersive interior has must-have tech and mandatory comforts, but it’s the driver-focused cockpit—including
a pistol-grip shifter, refined textures and race-inspired styling—that creates a visceral driving feel. Available
Attitude Adjustment Lighting wraps the cockpit in a 270-degree glow and reacts to actions like engine start up or
door opening. Choose from 64 colors to create the right mood.
Dodge Charger Scat Pack 2-Door interior in Black with 16-inch instrument cluster and 12.3-inch touchscreen radio.

pages.text:
W I D E B O D Y ,
B I G A T T I T U D E
Charger Scat Pack and Daytona Scat Pack don’t just show up—they show off.
The standard widebody stance is a modern flex on a deep muscle car legacy
that’s sculpted for performance, speed and domination. The overall design
amplifies the available staggered tire placement to create more grip where you
need it, sharper handling up front and acceleration that pins you to the seat.
The Daytona Scat Pack keeps it slick with an aerodynamic R-wing, channeling air
over the hood for downforce without ditching the signature muscle car presence.
The Charger Scat Pack is a slightly different beast but shares the same attitude.
Its exterior design features a unique hood with performance bulge. A redesigned
fascia with larger lower inlets and dual exhaust seals the deal.
Dodge Charger Scat Pack 2-door shown in Green Machine.
